scenario: 今天生成式赛道只入选 2 篇，研究对象都不是推荐系统本身，但都用到生成式推荐里常见的做法：先把对象压成离散编码，和 SID 的思路类似，再在编码上做生成或预测。LatentDiff 把整张知识图谱压成一组向量，用扩散模型从残缺的图一步步生成补全的图，补回了切子图的方法够不到的关系。蚂蚁国际的 ID2Pattern 不记卡号和设备号本身，只记它们在交易序列里怎么出现，再归成几类离散的行为模式，换成没见过的新号码也照样有效。关心新 ID 冷启动的团队可以先看 ID2Pattern。

papers.title: From Local Recovery to Unified Generation: Discovering Triple Set in Knowledge Graphs via Observation-Anchored Latent Diffusion
papers.authors: Jiaqi Wang, Yisen Gao, Huayang Shi, Junhao Hou, Wengen Li, Jihong Guan, Yichao Zhang, Shuigeng Zhou, Yangqiu Song, Hong Cheng
papers.abstract: Triple set prediction (TSP) is to recover missing relational triples in a knowledge graph by predicting the triple set instead of isolated links. Existing approaches predominantly rely on the subgraph-based completion paradigm, where the original graph is first partitioned into local subgraphs which are then independently completed. Such a paradigm suffers from fragmented structural reasoning, limited cross subgraph dependency modeling, and missing predictions across subgraphs. This paper proposes LatentDiff, a novel unified latent generative framework for TSP, which reformulates knowledge graph completion as latent space graph generation. LatentDiff first learns a compact latent representation using a relation-aware residual-quantized knowledge graph autoencoder, which encodes the whole graph into relation-aware latent embeddings, quantizes them with chunked residual codebooks, and reconstructs triples through a factorized decoder. papers.summary: 补全知识图谱里缺失的关系，可以不再把大图切成小子图分别补。一条缺失关系的两端如果分在不同子图，哪个子图都补不出来，在 Wiki79k 数据集上两成多的待补关系是这种情况。LatentDiff 用自编码器把整张图压成一组向量：每个实体在每种关系下一个向量，要能从中还原出它通过这种关系连着的实体。训练时把完整图的向量一步步推向残缺图的向量，每步掺一点噪声；扩散模型学的是反过来走，从残缺图还原出完整图。这样跨子图的关系也能补回一部分：Wiki79k 上这类关系有 3,391 条，切图方法一条没找回，LatentDiff 找回 178 条。

papers.title: ID2Pattern: Pretraining Generalizable Identity Behavior Patterns for Transaction Risk Foundation Models
papers.authors: Ze Zhao, Haoyu Jiang, Weiyu Han, Ruobing Zuo, Xiao Tan, Shuai Chen, Tianyi Zhang
papers.abstract: Large-scale behavioral pretraining offers a promising route to generalizable representations in online payment systems. However, high-cardinality identity fields such as card, device, and account IDs, though rich in behavioral signals, remain underexploited. Their continually growing vocabularies and limited semantic meaning make existing vocabulary-based and semantics-based encodings ill-suited. Their generalizable signal lies not in specific values, but in the identity behavior patterns they exhibit across a transaction sequence. Building on this insight, we propose ID2Pattern, a pretraining framework that brings these patterns into transaction foundation models. ID2Pattern first encodes identity fields with a Local Anonymous ID (LAID) tokenizer, which captures how each identity appears and recurs within the sequence, independent of its specific value. It then pretrains a multi-scale pattern codebook on unlabeled sequences, which abstracts LAID sequences into discrete behavior patter
papers.summary: 蚂蚁国际让支付风控模型用上卡号、设备号、账号这类字段，办法是不记号码本身，只记它在交易序列里怎么出现：是第几个出现的、是不是头一回、出现过几次、隔了几笔又出现。号码本身没有意义，新卡新设备又天天冒出来，给每个号码学一个 embedding 学不好。但行为规律是通用的：一个人一直用同一张卡和同一台设备，突然换了台新设备，这本身就是风险信号，与设备号无关。在超过一亿条序列的支付风控数据上，AUC 比不用这些字段的线上模型相对高 4.13%；把测试集里的号码全部换成训练时没见过的新号码，==结果完全不变，因为它从没记过号码本身==。
